name: STARTUP
notes: Stable target is defined by receiving the expected vehicle HEARTBEAT, then observing a three-second passive warmup.
traffic_origin: Passive UDP receive only; no PARAM or MAV_CMD request was sent.

name: BASELINE
notes: This phase is measured after target HEARTBEAT and passive warmup. It is kept separate so later request responses are not classified as default streams.
traffic_origin: Passive firmware-default stream only; no outbound request and no harness heartbeat.

name: PARAMETER_DOWNLOAD
notes: Full runtime parameter enumeration. Source defaults are never substituted.
traffic_origin: Harness GCS HEARTBEAT plus PARAM_REQUEST_LIST/PARAM_REQUEST_READ; no PARAM_SET.

name: REQUEST_SWEEP
notes: ACK and message observation are recorded independently. A message seen in the request window is not claimed causal when it was already a baseline stream.
traffic_origin: One serial MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE (command 512) per frozen all.xml message ID.

name: RELEVANT_STREAM_SAMPLE
notes: This phase follows and is excluded from the passive baseline and request sweep.
traffic_origin: MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL for selected AP-observation messages, then timed receive.
